children: Strategic collaboration agreement explores interoperability between Telesat Lightspeed advanced low Earth orbit network and Cailabs’ production-ready optical ground systems to provide resilient, high-capacity space-to-ground communications
ARLINGTON, Va., Sept. 01, 2026
-- Telesat Government Solutions, a wholly owned subsidiary of

Corporation (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT), and Cailabs US, Inc. today announced the signing of a strategic collaboration agreement to explore the integration of secure, resilient and high-capacity optical space-to-ground connectivity for U.S. Government and Allied missions.

Under the terms of the agreement, the companies will explore integration of the optical inter-satellite links on the Telesat Lightspeed low Earth orbit (LEO) spacecraft with Cailabs’ production-ready optical ground systems, deployment capabilities and ground network expertise. Together, they will pursue joint studies and demonstrations of this combined capability for U.S. Government opportunities, including space data relay services.

“Government users need communications architectures that combine resilience, security and high capacity with the flexibility to operate across space and terrestrial networks,” said Chuck Cynamon, President of Telesat Government Solutions. “We believe that combining Telesat Lightspeed with Cailabs’ mature optical ground capabilities creates the potential to offer differentiated solutions designed for the demanding, sovereign connectivity requirements of U.S. and Allied missions.”

The Telesat Lightspeed LEO network is purpose-built to deliver secure, resilient, and high-performance connectivity for mission-critical defense and government applications worldwide. The network is designed to offer services in both commercial Ka-band and Mil-Ka spectrum, enabling flexible support for a broad range of operational requirements while helping ensure protected communications in contested environments. Designed with security and survivability in mind, the Telesat Lightspeed LEO network features a space-based mesh architecture supported by 900 optical inter-satellite link terminals, creating a secure space-based backbone that routes traffic in orbit and enhances network resilience, availability, and global reach.

Cailabs complements this architecture with fixed and transportable optical ground stations designed for operational deployment. Its ground systems use proprietary atmospheric turbulence compensation technology and have already routinely established optical space-to-ground links with satellites equipped with TESAT SCOT80 terminals, the same terminal family selected for Telesat Lightspeed.

“Telesat Lightspeed brings the scale and advanced network architecture required to make optical connectivity a core capability for government missions,” said Jeff Huggins, President of Cailabs US. “Combined with Cailabs’ proven ground systems and industrial deployment capacity, it gives customers a credible path to secure, resilient and operational space-to-ground services.”

Cailabs has deployed optical ground systems at customer and partner sites in several regions and is expanding its industrial capacity to support deployment at scale, with a target production capacity of up to 50 optical ground stations per year.

The collaboration positions Telesat Government Solutions and Cailabs to address government requirements with an integrated space and ground architecture, combining advanced in-orbit networking with industrialized optical ground infrastructure.
About Cailabs

Cailabs is an industrial laser communications company building the ground systems that make optical links deployable at scale. Founded in 2013, with operations in France and the United States, Cailabs designs, manufactures and deploys optical communication systems for space-to-ground and ground-to-ground links.

Cailabs focuses on turning laser communications into operational infrastructure. Its systems are engineered for field deployment, integration into existing networks, remote operation and scalable rollouts, supporting customers in space, defense and critical network environments. By combining product design, manufacturing capability and operational support, Cailabs helps move optical communications from controlled demonstrations to real-world missions.

Cailabs’ solutions are powered by proprietary beam-shaping and atmospheric turbulence mitigation technologies, enabling robust high-capacity optical links through the atmosphere. Beyond laser communications, Cailabs applies the same light-shaping expertise to industrial laser processing and fiber networks, where performance, reliability and deployability are also critical.
About Telesat Government Solutions

Telesat U.S. Services, LLC (dba Telesat Government Solutions) is a wholly owned, U.S.-incorporated subsidiary of leading satellite operator Telesat Corporation. Telesat Government Solutions provides reliable and secure global communications networks that the U.S. Government and allies require and the information superiority and mission assurance they demand. Telesat Government Solutions offers resilient infrastructure and real-time operations management, leveraging the most cutting-edge satellite technologies.
About Telesat

Telesat Corporation (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) (“Telesat”) is a global satellite operator and leader in advanced satellite communications, redefining broadband connectivity through its Telesat Lightspeed low Earth orbit (LEO) network.

Designed from inception for interoperability with enterprise and government applications, Telesat Lightspeed delivers secure, resilient, high-performance broadband connectivity with fibre-like speeds. Its advanced, software-defined architecture operates in both commercial and military Ka-band spectrum, enabling mission-critical communications with enhanced security and protection against evolving threats. Purpose-built to meet the most demanding requirements, Telesat Lightspeed provides telecom, enterprise, aviation, maritime and defense customers with unprecedented flexibility and control to dynamically manage their own services and deliver differentiated, end-to-end connectivity solutions worldwide.

With nearly 60 years of innovation, engineering excellence and a collaborative approach to customer success, Telesat is uniquely positioned to deliver secure, scalable and future-ready connectivity solutions that help customers solve their most complex communications challenges and achieve mission success.
